facts.detail: The West Sussex public review was published on 4 February 2022.
The consultation page was last updated on 23 June 2026.
The official page records the consultation as concluded.
A West Sussex public-review closure notice is available.
The outcome includes a postcode map.
The outcome includes an ODS postcode list.

The preceding OMR ran from 12 August to 13 September 2021.

facts.detail: The Suffolk closure notice was updated on 23 June 2026.
The notice concerns procurement to extend gigabit-capable coverage in Suffolk.
The process sequence is OMR, public review, intervention-area determination and procurement.
BDUK uses White, Grey, Black and Under Review premises classifications.
White premises are eligible, but not every eligible premise must be targeted for subsidy.
The preceding Suffolk OMR ran from 15 March to 22 April 2021.
The public review ran from 19 August to 20 September 2021.
The public review sought stakeholder validation of OMR outcomes.
A May 2026 redesign covers around 60,000 premises.
The redesign is backed by up to £118.2 million, while national OMR returns are collected in January, May and September.
